send an arbitrary Jev request read from --input

Usage: overseer-judge raw [OPTIONS] --input <path|->

Options:
      --input <path|->       Request JSON to send; - reads stdin
      --pretty[=<PRETTY>]    Indent JSON output
      --dry-run[=<DRY_RUN>]  Print the request that would be sent and exit 0
      --model <name>         Jev model (default from TYPESAFE_DEFAULT_MODEL)
      --timeout <duration>   Timeout for each HTTP attempt; 0 or negative disables it [default: 10s]
      --log-level <level>    Stderr diagnostics [default: warn] [possible values: debug, info, warn, error]
  -h, --help                 Print help
  -V, --version              Print version

Output: the System One response as one JSON object.

Example:
  printf '%s' '{"state":"Payouts have failed for 3 days.",
    "questions":{"urgent":{"type":"noul",
    "instructions":"Does this convey urgency?"}}}' |
    overseer-judge raw --input - --pretty
